feature: Team management: list members, view profiles, change roles, remove members, access billing and audit log

actors.session_context: Login as org admin; use Cookie: session=admin_tok_abc
Login as a regular org member; use Cookie: session=member_tok_xyz
Send request with no Cookie or Authorization header

comparison_matrix.oracle: member receives 200 response body containing stripe_customer_id field
anonymous receives 200 response body with any billing field present
member receives 200 and response body contains events[] array with org-wide actions

comparison_matrix.actor_a_expected: 200 OK, target user role updated to admin
comparison_matrix.oracle: member receives 200 and subsequent GET /api/v1/team/usr_892 returns role:admin

comparison_matrix.actor_a_expected: 204 No Content, user removed from org
comparison_matrix.oracle: member receives 204 or 200 and subsequent GET /api/v1/team returns usr_892 absent from list

comparison_matrix.actor_a_expected: 200 OK with full member object including stripe_customer_id and internal_notes
comparison_matrix.actor_b_expected: 200 OK but with stripped profile (no internal fields) or 403
comparison_matrix.oracle: member response body contains stripe_customer_id or internal_notes fields

property_level_checks.oracle: stripe_customer_id key present in response JSON for member actor proves property-level filtering is absent
internal_notes key present in response JSON for member actor — exposes internal churn risk annotations to non-admin users
last_login_ip key present in response JSON for member actor — exposes PII of other members

regression_triggers: A new role (e.g. billing_viewer, security_auditor) is introduced to the permission model
Any refactor of the team management API serializer or permission middleware
API version bump (v2 endpoints) that may duplicate the team/billing routes without inheriting permission checks
SSO or SAML integration that may map external IdP roles to internal org_admin without review
summary: A member-role actor can escalate to org_admin by calling POST /api/v1/team/:user_id/role if the endpoint lacks role-based authorization, and can read full billing data including stripe_customer_id from /api/v1/billing
